# Cloudless

> Websites, cloud infrastructure, and AI automations for small teams that have
> been let down before — fixed scope, no lock-in, measurable results in 14 days.
> Cloudless (cloudless.gr) is a Greek cloud/serverless consultancy and product
> studio serving EU clients in English and Greek.

## Main sections

- [Homepage](https://cloudless.gr/en): productized cloud, serverless and AI
  automation offers for small teams.
- [Services](https://cloudless.gr/en/services): fixed-scope service packages
  (cloud migration, serverless backends, AI marketing automation).
- [Docs](https://cloudless.gr/en/docs): product and API documentation index.
- [Playbooks](https://cloudless.gr/playbooks): operational playbooks.
- [Blog](https://cloudless.gr/en/blog): engineering notes and case studies.
- [Contact](https://cloudless.gr/en/contact): book a free 30-minute audit.
- [Legal](https://cloudless.gr/en/privacy): privacy policy; also
  [terms](https://cloudless.gr/en/terms),
  [cookies](https://cloudless.gr/en/cookies),
  [accessibility](https://cloudless.gr/en/accessibility),
  [refunds](https://cloudless.gr/en/refund).

## Agent-facing surfaces

- [API catalog](https://cloudless.gr/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727
  linkset of public JSON APIs (chat, docs, calendar, analytics, health).
- [ARD capability manifest](https://cloudless.gr/.well-known/ai-catalog.json):
  agentic resource discovery entries.
- [Docs index API](https://cloudless.gr/api/docs): machine-readable doc list.
- [Chat API](https://cloudless.gr/api/chat): assistant endpoint (JSON POST).
- [Health](https://cloudless.gr/api/health): liveness endpoint.
- [auth.md](https://cloudless.gr/auth.md): agent auth & registration guide.
- [Agent skills](https://cloudless.gr/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json):
  published Agent Skills for this site.

Pages accept `Accept: text/markdown` and return Markdown
(`Content-Type: text/markdown`) — see /llms-full.txt for the expanded index.
